purpose: Rename the volume directories to match the volume numbers. Input of tools/renumber_dirs.py. For every path the first rule that matches wins; the same rules move tracked, ignored and untracked files.
attribution_rule: A path belongs to the volume of its run code (the pNN prefix of a result directory or a script), not to the directory it was written in. A script used by more than one volume stays with its earliest user, which for every shared script here is the run of its own name. The cross-volume imports this leaves are computed by the script after the move (PATH_MAP.json, cross_volume_imports), not listed by hand.

moves.why: P54 (NIM 2.0.12 against upstream vLLM on Llama 3.1 8B) is a Vol.1 run

run_codes_rule: Applied before `moves`: an entry <old root>/results/<run code>_... or <old root>/scripts/[run_]<run code>_... goes to <volume>/results|scripts/..., whichever old root holds it. P69 (Vol.2 clean re-runs) and P70 (Vol.1 clean re-check) are listed before their files exist.

kept_as_pushed.vol2-published: Vol.3 (then called Vol.2, Nemotron), directory vol2/

note_on_frozen_paths: Frozen harnesses import with paths written at the time (for example os.path.join(REPO, "vol2", "scripts")). They are bound by SHA-256 and are not edited, so they run as written only at the tag of their volume. PATH_MAP.md maps every old path.
